# Ignav Flights MCP

Search airport codes and live one-way or round-trip flight fares with booking links through Ignav’s official MCP server. An Ignav account is required. Successful calls consume account usage credits and may incur charges after the free allowance. Ignav returns booking links; it does not buy tickets or manage reservations.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ignav-flights-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Search airports** (read-only): Find airport IATA codes by city, airport name, metro area, or code.
- **Search flights** (read-only): Search one-way or round-trip flight prices between two IATA airport codes.
